verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant that answers based on your notes and can propose creates and updates for you to approve [42]. Its AI chats let you pass specific blocks or notes as context [23], and AI is fully opt-in, with no space data shared with third-party AI services unless you activate it [16]. Together these cover grounded Q&A and drafting, plus basic data-exposure controls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of summarization, granular controls for excluding specific notes or spaces from AI access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
